value.syntax: # [doc = " Input fields, with opaque encoded proof carriage rather than a proof verdict."] # [doc = " (´def:wallet:input-layout´)"] # [derive (Clone , Debug , Eq , PartialEq)] pub struct Input { # [doc = " Transaction identifier and masked output index."] pub outpoint : Vec < u8 > , # [doc = " Peg-in flag."] pub pegin : bool , # [doc = " Public script bytes."] pub script : Vec < u8 > , # [doc = " Consensus sequence."] pub sequence : u32 , # [doc = " Encoded issuance, including its nonce, entropy and both amounts."] pub issuance : Vec < u8 > , # [doc = " Whether the codec found a non-null issuance."] pub has_issuance : bool , # [doc = " Complete encoded input witness."] pub witness : Vec < u8 > , }
